svg.title: Client-Side State Machines and Their Interactions

g.text: Client-Side State Machines and Their Interactions
PendingCallRegistry is omitted from the flow arrows for readability and since it is not a state machine.
It maps request_id to PendingCall, enforces the outstanding-call limit, and
mediates completion, failure, and timeout operations.
Solid arrows: state transitions within a client state machine.
Dashed arrows: interactions between the application, session,
individual pending calls, and transport callbacks.
C1-C3 (blue): transport StateCallback and pending-call failure.
Related triggers on one dashed arrow share the same source and target;
each trigger ID identifies a separate interaction in that grouped flow.
SendRequest waits for kReady before registering a pending call.
A connection that stops fails all registered calls. A response without a
matching request_id is discarded by the omitted registry mediator.
